latest.name: Qwen — Multimodal AI Assistant (Qwen Studio)
latest.developer: Alibaba Cloud (Singapore) Private Limited. Google Play lists Alibaba Qwen Team; the store's developer legal entity is NTH POWER GLOBAL TECH SINGAPORE PTE. LTD.
latest.category: General-purpose, research, reasoning and multimodal AI
latest.short_verdict: A broad multimodal AI workspace combining chat, web search, Deep Research, artifacts, image editing/generation and video generation. Qwen describes the service as free to use, but public pages do not state a fixed chat or media-generation quota; standard limits and feature availability can vary. Its biggest caveat is data handling: the terms say prompts must not be confidential or proprietary and allow certain non-personal user content to be used to improve AI services.
latest.what_it_does: Qwen is Alibaba's general-purpose AI assistant. The current product site lists thinking/reasoning, web search, developer tools, artifacts, Deep Research, image generation and video generation. Its Android listing also describes chat, writing, translation, image/document analysis and image/video creation. The service terms say supported prompts may include text, documents, images, videos and audio; which model and tools are available can vary by account, region and feature.
latest.why_try_it: It offers one place to test general chat and reasoning, multi-step web research, document/image questions and creative image/video workflows without committing to a subscription first. Compared with a privacy-first multi-model relay, Qwen is a first-party assistant suite with its own research and media-creation tools.
latest.free_tier: Qwen's official homepage describes the assistant as free to use and open to all. The web/app experience is freemium: the Google Play app is free to install and shows in-app purchases, while free use is subject to standard and feature-specific limits. The official public pages checked do not publish a fixed number of free chat messages, daily requests, file uploads, image generations, video credits or reset intervals; treat the in-product usage indicator as authoritative for the account.
latest.limits: No public numeric free quota or complete consumer pricing table could be verified. Standard usage limits, model access, image/video generation allowances and availability may change or vary by account, region and demand; the app listing indicates in-app purchases. Qwen's terms require users not to submit confidential or proprietary material. They also permit Qwen to use and store non-personal User Content to develop and improve machine-learning/AI technologies and to process/store it outside the user's jurisdiction. Outputs may be inaccurate and require human verification. The service terms require users to be at least 18 or the age of majority, whichever is higher.
latest.signup_pakistan: The current Qwen Terms of Service do not name Pakistan as an excluded country, but they do not provide an exhaustive supported-country list and reserve discretion over account eligibility and service availability. Pakistan-based web signup and feature access were not independently tested. The official Android listing exists, but Pakistan-specific Play Store availability and Pakistani payment-card acceptance for in-app purchases were not verified.
latest.quality_evidence: Independent platform/adoption evidence: the official Google Play listing showed 5M+ downloads, a 4.3-star rating and about 158K reviews when checked on 2026-11-15; these are store-reported adoption/ratings, not a controlled benchmark. Trustpilot showed 2.2/5 from 15 reviews, a very small self-selected sample, with complaints about filtering and inconsistent output alongside occasional positive reports. Anecdotal Reddit feedback includes users praising generous text/image use but also mentions slow responses and variable limits. Qwen publishes its own model benchmark tables, but those are vendor-reported; no independent benchmark tied to the exact live model selection in the hosted Qwen app was verified.
latest.android_status: Official Qwen Android app verified on Google Play (package com.tongyi.intl), published as Qwen by Alibaba Qwen Team. The listing showed 5M+ downloads, 4.3 stars, about 158K reviews and an update dated 2026-10-26 at the time checked. Play Store availability can vary by country.
